answer: Limit the pipes, not just the people: trust flows through a jade ledger where each edge carries only a few new identities per epoch, and a farm must find many honest doors instead of one open gate. An attacker who buys one established account still gets only a handful of entries per epoch — to mint a thousand fakes they would need hundreds of compromised sponsors, each expensive to acquire. Trust spreads like a mesa through narrow channels — wide enough for honest growth, too narrow for a flood.
